Optimize the token claiming process with NFC

"Claiming $POMO Tokens" is core reward mechanism. Explore favorite stores and offers via the app, then tap the NFC Tag during visits to claim tokens based on purchase amount while building membership tiers. 

Role

Product Designer

Company

POMO Network

Time

May 2024

[ What is $POMO ]

$POMO is the native token of the POMO Network that tokenizes consumer social effects and contributions.

Users earn these tokens through active participation within the ecosystem, allowing them to monetize their loyalty, upgrade membership levels, or pay for subscription fees.

[ How to claim $POMO ]

After each purchase, tap the NFC Tag and have the staff verify the transaction to receive a specific amount of tokens based on your spending.

[ Flow ]

[ User Feedback ]

24, A cashier in burger shop

Our average meal is only $100-200, but during lunch hour, the queue stretches out the door. It’s frustrating when a customer wants to claim their tokens but struggles to sign up the app.

30, Ａ solo staff in a grab-and-go cafe

Many commuters are interested in $POMO, but once they see the token claiming process at the counter, they give up because they're in a hurry.

35, Owner of a brunch restaurant

In my business, profit comes from volume. If the checkout system takes 30 seconds instead of 5, that's one less table I can turn over during peak hours.

[ Our Insight ]

For fast-paced, low-average-spend merchants, the current token flow is impractical and risks creating operational bottlenecks during peak hours.

  • [ UX Optimization ]

    We group our participating merchants into 3 tiers by their average transaction amount.

    Tier1: Over $1000, Tier2: $500 – $1000, Tier3: Under $500

    Type1

    For Tier3 Claim $POMO by Checking

    For merchants with an average spend below $500 (Tier 3), we have designed a streamlined process that eliminates staff verification, allowing users to claim fixed-ratio rewards directly.

    Type2

    For Tier1/Tier2 Claim $POMO through Staff Verification

    The original verification flow is retained for other tiers; upon successful verification, users receive a combination of fixed-ratio rewards + extra rewards.

  • [ Sybil Resistance Policy ]

    A security mechanism designed to prevent malicious actors from farming tokens by creating thousands of bot accounts.

    Extended mechanism for the “Type 1: Claim $POMO by Checking” flow.

    1.

    Claim up to five $POMO Tokens per day

    2.

    Claim up to two $POMO Tokens per store

    3.

    User need to active GPS and locate themselves at the merchant’s location
